source.title: New WEC Leader (August 2019)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Callum Goodyear will become the new Leader of the WCA Ethics Committee (WEC). Callum was already working as a member of the WEC.

Callum was selected by the WCA Board and was approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Walker Welch for the work he has done for the WEC, and wish Callum Goodyear best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

The new Leader will be promoted immediately. Callum was among two applicants we had and both candidacy documents can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1FxbJGkTB6k9abr7jJva4hUwtqMRYTd3g) if you are interested in viewing them.

translation.title: WCA 道德委员会新负责人（2019 年 8 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Callum Goodyear 将出任 WCA 道德委员会（WEC）的新任负责人。Callum 此前已是 WEC 成员。

WCA 董事会依照[《议案 10.2019.0：委员会与团队》](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节选出 Callum，并经现任委员会负责人及高级代表投票确认。

感谢 Walker Welch 为 WEC 所做的工作，祝 Callum Goodyear 在新的岗位上一切顺利。

新负责人将立即就任。我们共收到两份申请，Callum 是其中一位申请人。如有兴趣，两份申请材料均可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1FxbJGkTB6k9abr7jJva4hUwtqMRYTd3g)查看。
